title: EATF Agent Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Agent Evidence Packages (.aep): TypeScript and Python verifiers, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, JSON schemas, runnable examples, and positive/negative conformance vectors. Version 0.2.0 enforces RFC 3161 SHA-256 imprint equality and embedded CMS signature verification, and supports explicit signer-key pinning.
notes: Version 0.2.0 was archived as doi:10.5281/zenodo.21571908. The prior v0.1.2 archive is doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511609.
